metadata.description: Resource group that holds the SRE Agent resources.
Resource groups the agent can observe or act on. The agent resource group is always included.
Comma-separated resource groups the agent can observe or act on. Used by the Azure portal form.
Optional database-qualified FinOps Hub Kusto connector URI. Example: https://<cluster>.<region>.kusto.windows.net/Hub
Optional. FinOps Hub Azure Data Explorer cluster resource ID for Kusto viewer assignment.
Agent access level. Low (read-only) is recommended for reporting and analysis without modification risk.
Default SRE Agent model provider. MicrosoftFoundry maps to the Azure OpenAI provider in the SRE Agent portal.
Default SRE Agent model name. Automatic lets SRE Agent route to the appropriate model within the selected provider.
Assign Reader on the deployment subscription to the agent managed identity. Optional — required only for subscription-wide ARM-backed reports; otherwise scope reads via target resource groups.
Public URI for the generated SRE Agent recipe package. Deploy-to-Azure links derive this from the template URI.
SHA256 hash of the recipe package for integrity verification.
Forces the recipe deployment script to run when the template is redeployed.
Deterministic naming seed built from subscription ID, agent resource group ID, and agent name.
Resource group IDs shown as managed resources in the SRE Agent.
Resource group IDs to add as managed resources.
Principal ID of the managed identity to assign roles to.
